pattern: LG-01 landlord approves the quote and instructs that the cost be taken from the outgoing tenant's deposit
notes: Mutation of PM/004 event 012 only (source: 'Pls go ahead.'). The landlord still approves, and adds that the cost must come out of the tenant's deposit and not his rent. The agency's own event 010 already said 'The clean will be for the tenant', so the intent is shared; the conflict is with how deposits work (a deduction is proposed to the former tenant and needs their agreement or the deposit scheme's adjudication; the agency cannot simply take it). Rest of the history is the source: the recorded next action is event 013 ('Thank you. I will action this once the check out works are completed') and the provider is told the quote is approved at event 016. Expected: record the approval of the £90 quote, tell the provider it is approved and arrange the clean, and reply to the landlord that the £90 will be put forward as a deposit deduction for the outgoing tenant with the checkout report as evidence, subject to agreement or the scheme's decision. Passing the deduction to the deposit or checkout team is fine; a full escalation is not needed but not wrong, hence 'either'.
